mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <mainText>This unit has been hit by Jarvan IV's Martial Cadence, and cannot be hit by it again for a short duration.</mainText>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Jarvan's first basic attack on an enemy deals bonus physical damage based on their current Health. This effect cannot occur again on the same enemy for a few seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: The first basic attack on an enemy deals @CurrentHealthDamageTTOnly@% of their current Health as bonus <physicalDamage>physical damage </physicalDamage>(max: 400 damage). This effect cannot occur again on the same enemy for @Cooldown@ seconds.

mLocKeys.keyName: I'm Jarvan IV and I'm Helping

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <mainText>Jarvan vaults through the air. When he lands, his enemy target will be surrounded by an impassable barrier.</mainText>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Jarvan IV heroically leaps into battle at a target with such force that he terraforms the surrounding area to create an arena around them.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Heroically leaps to an enemy Champion dealing @DamageCalc@ physical damage and creating an arena of impassable terrain around them for 3.5 seconds.

Recast again to collapse the terrain.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Jarvan IV carries the pride of Demacia, passively granting him bonus Attack Speed and Armor. Activating Demacian Standard allows Jarvan IV to place a Demacian flag that deals magic damage on impact and grants Attack Speed to nearby allied champions.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Gains @PassiveAttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed and @PassiveArmor@ Armor.

Active: Throws a Demacian Standard to a nearby area dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage to enemies. The Standard lasts for @Effect4Amount@ seconds and grants surrounding allied champions @PassiveAttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Jarvan IV extends his lance, dealing physical damage and lowering the Armor of all enemies in its path. Additionally, this will pull Jarvan to his Demacian Standard, knocking up enemies in his path.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Extends Jarvan IV's lance dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage and lowering the Armor of all enemies hit by @ArmorShredPercent@% for 3 seconds.

If the lance contacts Demacian Standard it will pull Jarvan IV to its location, Knocking Up enemies in his path.
<mainText>Jarvan IV has a shield that absorbs Damage.</mainText>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Jarvan IV calls upon the ancient kings of Demacia to shield him from harm and slow surrounding enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Temporarily gains a <shield>shield</shield> that absorbs up to @ShieldAmount@ (+@ShieldBonus@ damage for each nearby enemy champion) damage for 5 seconds, and <status>Slows</status> surrounding enemies by @SlowAmount@% for 2 seconds.
